sources.title: GI CP-1600 Microprocessor Users Manual, May 1975
sources.note: Scanned image PDF (document code S16DOC-CP1600-04). Plan 01-02 verifies the cached copy against this digest. The manual describes the CP-1600; applying it to the CP-1610 is an inference. Electrical specifications in it are marked tentative.
